box_model_check.note: The spec is pinned to one item at fixed coordinates, so it cannot say anything about a differently sized popup. These are the four things the box model predicts -- the opaque fill, the top rule, the context divider and the bottom rule -- measured wherever they land, against Qud's own MenuControll from `uiprobe target=PopupMessage`. `exact` means every one landed on Qud's pixel row/column with zero delta.

popups.kind: menu + context, width driven by the ITEM NAME (393.61) not the commands (199.81)
AskString input, no context, 2 command entries
message, 1 command entry, width driven by the text
yes/no, 3 command entries, width driven by the COMMAND BAR
TITLED option list -- the only kind with a PolatFrameSuperHeader, and its box is sized by the TITLE

emblem_check.note: Qud's tree glyph ABOVE the box -- sprite `polat-frame-top`, the PolatFrameTopping child of PolatFrame, laid out 183x60 with its BOTTOM on the box top. Extracted first-party off the LIVE popup by the new `popupchrome` bridge command and drawn through the shared QudChrome.popup_emblem() accessor. Raves drew nothing here before. Re-measure with reports/2026-08-05-item-popup/measure_emblem.py -- it matches the glyph's flat tint, not brightness, because Qud dims the live playfield behind a modal rather than blanking it.
emblem_check.result: bbox, centre and tone EXACT. 418 pixels shared = 92.3% of Qud's ink.
emblem_check.residual: 35 px of the glyph's 1px central spine. It is an EXTRACTION limit, not a placement one: the atlas region holds the disc colour at alpha 128 at exactly those pixels, with no glyph tone to recover. Point sampling in WriteRegion changed the PNG by zero bytes; chargen_emblem.png (same art, different sprite) agrees worse (397); vertical-continuity growth reaches 447 but floods 316 disc pixels. Do not retry these three.
